_comment: Built-in layer catalog. Edit this file to add your PERSEUS data sources. Each entry needs `name`, `type` ('cog' or 'geojson'), and either a single `url` or a `times` array of timesteps. Optional `style` applies to rasters (colormap, min, max).
_data_hosting: Host your PERSEUS COGs on a CORS-enabled bucket (S3, R2, Azure Blob) so the browser can fetch byte-ranges. Set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

layers._comment: Example of a time-series layer. Each timestep is one COG. The slider will appear automatically when this layer is visible.
layers.name: Biomass projection (example time series)
layers.description: Replace URLs with your per-year PERSEUS COGs
